verdict.rationale: Projects give self-contained workspaces with their own knowledge bases and persistent files across conversations (claude-docs-16, claude-docs-62). Skills let users teach Claude repeatable, task-specific behavior (claude-docs-70, claude-docs-60), which roughly covers the 'build a custom assistant with knowledge' core. The evidence never shows these being packaged as standalone assistants or shared with others. missing for 10: evidence of sharing custom assistants or projects with other users, explicit per-assistant custom instructions, a dedicated custom-assistant builder, independent or hands-on corroboration.
